breakdown.description: The prompt computes reduction of area from a diameter ratio instead of from the initial and final cross-sectional areas.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly computes percent reduction of area using the initial and final cross-sectional areas (calculated from the diameters), with the formula 100 * (initial area - final area) / initial area. This matches the ground truth approach rather than the incorrect diameter ratio formula from the incomplete prompt.

breakdown.description: The prompt uses the final gage length in the denominator for percent elongation, whereas percent elongation is referenced to the original gage length.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the initial gage length in the denominator for percent elongation: 100 * (final gage length - initial gage length) / initial gage length. This matches the ground truth and corrects the error of using the final gage length in the denominator.
